title: Returned Payment Fee and Certified Funds Terms by Floor Plan
content:
These terms apply to payments made on an Apartment Home Lease that the bank or card network later dishonors. They are set per floor plan and read the same on all six.

| Floor plan | Company returned payment fee (before any state cap) | Returned payments within the trailing 365 days that place the lease on certified funds only | Length of the certified funds restriction | Instruments accepted while the restriction is in force |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | $50.00 | 2 | 12 calendar months | Money order, cashier's check |
| One-Bedroom Residence | $50.00 | 2 | 12 calendar months | Money order, cashier's check |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | $50.00 | 2 | 12 calendar months | Money order, cashier's check |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | $50.00 | 2 | 12 calendar months | Money order, cashier's check |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | $50.00 | 2 | 12 calendar months | Money order, cashier's check |
| Penthouse Residence | $50.00 | 2 | 12 calendar months | Money order, cashier's check |

**Company returned payment fee** — the company's fee per dishonored payment, stated before any state cap is applied.

**Trigger count** — the number of returned payments within the trailing 365 days that places the lease on certified funds only.

**Restriction length** — the length of a certified funds restriction, in calendar months counted from the date of the triggering return.

**Certified funds instruments** — the payment methods accepted while a certified funds restriction is in force: a money order or a cashier's check.

### In short

- One returned payment within the trailing 365 days does not reach the trigger count of 2; a second one does.
- The restriction runs 12 calendar months from the date of the return that triggers it.
- Card payments, bank transfers and autopay drafts are not certified funds on any floor plan.
